skills.name: Skybloom Lift

steps.text: Stack 3 Skybloom on all Guiding Light allies and Give Knockback Immunity (1 time)

skills.notes: XL, 20x of 160% = 3200% (원문 괄호). Skybloom 은 Guiding Light 아군에게만 — to 에 특성 필터가 없어 other

steps.text: Guiding Light characters only: Buff effects x2 (+60%)

skills.name: Swooning Spell
skills.notes: Stun 지속 원문 없음 — 1턴(기준 시트 관례)

steps.text: Restore all party members HP +50% and restore all statuses
Guiding Light characters only: Give Status immunity (3 times)
Guiding Light characters only: Buff time count x2 (6 moves) and Weakness Multiplier +1 (6 turns)
When Skybloom is stacked: Another Force Combo gain increased
Guiding Light characters only: Buff effects x2 (+80%)

skills.name: Intensive Research

steps.text: When Skybloom is stacked: Give all party members Barrier Pierce (1 time)

skills.notes: Skybloom 시 +700% (x8) = 1600% (위키 위값과 같음). Type Resistance(원소 미지정) = 「속성 저항」

steps.text: Guiding Light characters only: Buff effects x2 (+100%)

skills.name: Link Ability

steps.text: When 4 Arcadia characters are on the frontline: Grant Kaleido to all party members; Change element of all party members to fire

skills.notes: 「When Raging Fire Stance is deployed」 — 전개 순간인지 전개 중 상시인지 원문 불명, 존이 있는 동안 상시로 둠

skills.name: Stout Heart Stacking
skills.notes: 원문 「Gain +10 Stout Heart stacks at battle start」. 성도 「Battle Start Stout Heart Stacking」(+10)과 별개 출처로 봄

skills.name: Stout Heart Stacking - Turn Start
skills.notes: 「Gain stacks: from number of Guiding Light party members on the front lines at turn start」 = 전방 Guiding Light 수만큼 — gte 1·2·3 step 3개로 n = 인원 수(사잔카 자신은 Guiding Light 아님)

skills.name: Skybloom

steps.text: At turn start Consume one Skybloom Stack and give Hold Ground to unit with stack
At turn end if Unit with Stack is <25% HP: Consumes all stacks and restores Unit's HP and MP +100%

skills.notes: Skybloom 보유자는 Guiding Light 아군 — 시트 주인 밖 유닛의 턴 시작 소모는 v0 형식으로 못 씀

skills.name: Tensho Sazanka

steps.text: Guiding Light characters only: Buff effects x2
Give a Barrier to all party members with 50% damage reduction (1 time, Current Turn Only)
When used during Stellar Burst: Guiding Light characters only: Give Overthrow (3 turns)

skills.notes: XXL, 5x of 210% = 1050%. SB 시 +900% (x10) = 10500% (위키 위값). 「Any weapon equipped characters' damage +50%」 = 무기 대미지 그룹이 §3.5 에 없어 「대미지」로 둠. SB 각성 (3 turns-) many times per battle — once 아님

steps.text: Awakens any Elemental Type Zones or a Damage Type Attack Zones or some Hybrid Zones (Double Strike Stance Attack Zones, Moonlight Stance); doubles zone multipliers; cannot be overwritten; removed after duration; once per character via active skills — 규칙 설명(엔진 awaken 이 처리)
When Stellar Burst is activated with user and Gauge has majority Light: Fire type resistance of all enemies -25% (Current Turn Only)
When there are 2 or more Dragon Killer party members on the front line: User's Stellar Burst Gauge Fill rate increases (S)

notes: 「When Skybloom is stacked」 — 누구의 Skybloom 인지 원문 불명. Skybloom 은 Skybloom Lift 로 Guiding Light 아군에게만 쌓이고 사잔카 자신은 Guiding Light 가 아니다 → text 조건(엔진은 거짓)으로 둠. Junretsu Ranbu · Intensive Research 의 x8 과 Swooning Spell 의 Pain/Poison 은 v0 에서 안 나간다
Guiding Light 전용 x2(Check-Up · House Call · Treatment · Bitter Medicine · Tensho Sazanka)는 대상 특성 필터가 없어 other — 기본값만 파티 전체에
전투 시작 Stout Heart = 기본 패시브 +10 + 성도 패시브 +10 = 20(최대)으로 봄 → 1턴부터 Skybloom Lift. 같은 10 을 두 곳에 적은 것이면 10 이 맞다(확인 필요)
VC 의 Raging Fire Stance 전개(VC 미반영)와 SB 전개만 있어 v0 에서 존은 안 깔린다 — Link Ability 는 다른 캐릭터가 존을 깔 때만 의미
passive(Link Ability · Skybloom · Another Zone · SB 보너스)는 엔진 v0 에서 실행되지 않는다
